stem: In a small office, 5 employees earn ₱18,000 a month, 3 earn ₱21,000 and 2 earn ₱27,000. What is the average monthly salary of the 10 employees?
hints: Five people earn the lowest salary. Each person counts once, so each salary counts as many times as there are people earning it.
Add the three totals, then divide by the 10 employees.

solution.methodName: Weighted average: add group totals, divide by total count

steps.why: By hand, work in thousands: 5 × 18 = 90, so ₱90,000.
Dividing by 10 drops one zero from the end: 207,000 becomes 20,700.

trapNotes.₱22,000: This is the average of the three salary levels: (₱18,000 + ₱21,000 + ₱27,000) ÷ 3. More people earn ₱18,000, so that salary must count more.
trapNotes.₱69,000: This is ₱207,000 ÷ 3, dividing by the 3 salary levels. Divide by the 10 employees instead.
trapNotes.₱207,000: This is the total payroll for the month. Divide it by the 10 employees to get the average.
